prompt:
A web console page for an autonomous software factory, seen whole. The top
bar is decided and fixed: one 44 px strip between two 1 px hairline rules,
quiet small-capitals words, no boxes or pills around links. Left to right:
"FACTORY CONSOLE" (the product name, slightly heavier), the project select
"ai-software-factory-code ▾", then the one bordered word "New task"; a wide
gap; the figures group "COSTS · RESOURCES"; a wide gap; the running group
"SETTINGS · POLICY · NOTIFICATIONS"; at the right a moon icon, "sebastian",
"LOG OUT". The open page's word "RESOURCES" is cyan with a short underline
beneath it; no other bar word is colored. The page below fills the rest.

The page's exact content, and nothing more — do not invent rows, sections,
numbers, badges, filters, search boxes, pagination or charts. Only the
content between the CONTENT markers. All text must be crisp and legible,
spelled exactly as given.
DESIGN DIRECTION 2 — LEDGER. The page is one continuous accounting table,
like a page of a bound ledger. Not one table per project: a single ruled
table spanning the full content width, where each project begins with a
small-caps divider row (project name left, envelope figures right, a heavier
1 px rule above it) and its rows follow. Every column keeps its exact
alignment down the whole page, so the eye can scan "EUR/h" or "State"
straight from top to bottom. Row height generous, ~40 px, single hairline
between rows, no fills, no zebra. The header row of column names appears
once, at the top, pinned under the page heading, quiet small caps. The jobs
section and the demo-app section are divider rows of the same continuous
table (their differing columns merge gracefully: empty cells stay empty,
never invented). The "gone" line is a dim italic row inside the table. Acts
are quiet words in the last column. Totals feel engraved rather than
highlighted: the envelope figures in the divider rows are the only bold text
on the page. The impression: one long ruled sheet, serious, financial.
CONTENT — the Resources page of project ai-software-factory-code.

Heading: "Resources". Intro sentence, muted: "Servers the agents
commissioned, open now or closed in the last 7 days. Promote makes a
commission standing; Release ends it."

Section "AI-SOFTWARE-FACTORY-CODE" — envelope line, small figures:
"task block €10.00 a month · this month €0.43, 1 open server · standing:
none". Table, columns: Task · Resource · Type · IPv4 · Lease ends · EUR/h ·
Cost so far · State · Acts. Rows:
"#606 | firewall 70 | — | — | in 2 h | — | — | live | Release"
"#606 | server 71 · acceptance run against a fresh Postgres | cx23 |
203.0.113.24 | in 2 h | 0.0072 | 0.01 | live | Promote · Release"
"#571 | server 58 | cx33 | — | released by sebastian | 0.0144 | 0.06 |
deleted | —"

Section "INFRA" — the cluster's scheduled jobs, columns: Name · Kind ·
Namespace · Schedule · Last run · State. Rows:
"backup | CronJob | factory | nightly 02:00 | 7 h ago | ok"
"forgejo-dump | CronJob | factory | daily 03:00 | 31 h ago | ok"

Section "DEMO-APP" — envelope line: "task block €30.00 a month · this month
€0.00 · standing block €12.00 a month: 1 now, €5.99". Table, same columns as
the first, one row:
"— | server 64 | cx23 | — | standing, made standing by sebastian | — |
€5.99 a month | live | Release"

Section "GONE" — no table, one dim line: "no file in the configuration:
nothing acts on this project".

END OF CONTENT.
PALETTE (light): page background #f1ece0 (warm paper), no page gradient;
panel background where a surface is needed #faf6ec; hairline rules #d8cfba
(1 px); text #0f1d33; muted text #5d6b80; faint text #7a8698; teal #0a6a80
reserved for the open page's word in the bar and for links, nothing else;
burnt amber #8a4f00 only where a state needs attention, and sparingly.
Words in a 13 px humanist sans; every figure, ID, address, type name and
time in a tabular monospace. Dense but calm: a mission-control readout, not
a marketing page. Rendered at 1440×900, desktop.
